metadata.title: Generalizing the Gaster--Loustau Theorem via Generalized Discrete Markov Spectra
metadata.abstract: We realize generalized Markov numbers (GM numbers) for arbitrary $k_1,k_2,k_3\in \mathbb Z_{\ge0}$ as $\lambda$-lengths of return arcs on a hyperbolic orbifold constructed from local monodromy matrices. The McShane identity of Tan--Wong--Zhang on this orbifold yields a summation identity with multiplicities for the gaps between the associated Markov--Lagrange constants and their limiting value, together with a summation inequality that counts each distinct value once. These results extend the summation identity and inequality of Gaster and Loustau to generalized Markov numbers.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 广义 Markov 谱的双曲弧长实现
analysis.workSummary: 对任意非负整数 k₁,k₂,k₃，用局部 monodromy 矩阵构造双曲 orbifold，使广义 Markov 数实现为返回弧的 λ 长度。
analysis.breakthrough: 由 Tan–Wong–Zhang 恒等式得到谱值与极限差的带重数求和恒等式，以及对不同谱值各计一次的求和不等式，推广 Gaster–Loustau 结果。
analysis.limitations: 带重数恒等式与去重不等式的计数规则需保留。摘要未给一般参数下的谱值重数分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
